title: Assurance-case defeater, rebuttal, and residual-uncertainty argument graph
hypothesis: A typed assurance graph can reject a readiness argument when a live defeater lacks an evidence-backed rebuttal, residual uncertainty is hidden, evidence is stale, or a domain veto is averaged away.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate claim, evidence link, freshness, defeater state, rebuttal independence, uncertainty owner, domain veto, and readiness class; unsupported, circular, stale, hidden, or promoted arguments must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural or proxy software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the declared synthetic tribunal and does not promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
